title: [Level 3] 'enter ready' clause not applied when playing Scorchclaw with 3+ XP
expected: Parser output for Scorchclaw (verified by running parseAbilities on its rulesText) is {type:'static', condition:{type:'while-level',threshold:3}, effect:{type:'sequence', effects:[{type:'modify-might',...},{type:'enter-ready',...}]}}. In packages/riftbound-engine/src/game-definition/moves/play/cost.ts:63-69, staticEnterReadyApplies() reads only the top-level ability.effect.type and `continue`s when it !== 'enter-ready' — no sequence unwrapping — so it returns false; hasStaticEffect() (cost.ts:32-44) has the same top-level-only check. play-unit.ts:525 uses staticEnterReadyApplies to decide entersReady, so the unit enters exhausted. evaluateEnterReadyCondition (cost.ts:77-130) also has no 'while-level' case (falls to default undefined). By contrast static-abilities.ts:694-697 does unwrap `sequence` effects, which is why the +1 Might half applies while enter-ready does not.
observed: Played via playUnit at XP=4: card meta.exhausted=true, DOM class 'card--exhausted' (the +1 Might half of the same ability DID apply: staticMightBonus=1, Effective Might 4). Root cause: engine cost.ts staticEnterReadyApplies()/hasStaticEffect() only match a static ability whose top-level effect.type==='enter-ready'; the parser emits this ability as {type:'static', condition:{type:'while-level',threshold:3}, effect:{type:'sequence', effects:[modify-might, enter-ready]}}, so the nested enter-ready is never seen (and the while-level condition is not evaluated by evaluateEnterReadyCondition either).
